row: Inner Dynamics Physical Therapy is the largest pelvic health center in New Jersey, with two office locations in Ocean and Toms River. We treat pelvic pain, pelvic organ prolapse, pre-partum/post-partum, pelvic floor dysfunction, male pelvic pain, low back, hip, abdominal, and groin pain, bladder dysfunction, constipation, post-surgical conditions, and general orthopedic conditions. We especially love educating our community about pelvic health, so no one had to live silently in pain. We enjoy sharing the latest pelvic floor techniques, and are the pelvic health  consultants to USA Weightlifting and USA Powerlifting. We work with women, men, and children of all ages. For more information, check out our website at innerdynamicspt.com
